instruction:
Dual-Mode Production Line Control Function Block

### Instruction

Purpose:
Implement a function block (FB_ProductionLineControl) that manages a production line system with manual and automatic operation modes. The system controls product movement through three processing stations using sensors, buttons, and motor control.

Input Variables:
- Mode: BOOL - Operation mode selection (FALSE: Manual, TRUE: Automatic)
- ForwardButton: BOOL - Manual forward control button
- ReverseButton: BOOL - Manual reverse control button
- SensorA: BOOL - Position sensor at station A
- SensorB: BOOL - Position sensor at station B
- SensorC: BOOL - Position sensor at station C
- ButtonA: BOOL - Process activation button at station A
- ButtonB: BOOL - Process activation button at station B
- ButtonC: BOOL - Process activation button at station C

Output Variables:
- MotorForward: BOOL - Forward motor control signal
- MotorReverse: BOOL - Reverse motor control signal
- CompletionLight: BOOL - Process completion indicator

Internal Variables:
- State: INT - State machine control variable (Initialize to 0)

Implementation Requirements:

1. Initialization:
When State = 0:
- Set all outputs (MotorForward, MotorReverse, CompletionLight) to FALSE
- Set State to 1

2. Manual Mode Operation (Mode = FALSE):
a. Forward Motion:
- IF ForwardButton AND NOT ReverseButton:
* Set MotorForward = TRUE
* Set MotorReverse = FALSE

b. Reverse Motion:
- IF ReverseButton AND NOT ForwardButton:
* Set MotorForward = FALSE
* Set MotorReverse = TRUE

c. Stop Condition:
- IF both buttons pressed or neither pressed:
* Set both MotorForward and MotorReverse to FALSE

3. Automatic Mode Operation (Mode = TRUE):
Implement state machine with following states:

State 1: Waiting at Station A
- Wait for SensorA activation
- On activation: Transition to State 2
- Keep motors off

State 2: Processing at Station A
- Wait for ButtonA press
- On press: 
* Set MotorForward = TRUE
* Set MotorReverse = FALSE
* Transition to State 3

State 3: Moving to Station B
- Wait for SensorB activation
- On activation: 
* Set MotorForward = FALSE
* Transition to State 4

State 4: Processing at Station B
- Wait for ButtonB press
- On press:
* Set MotorForward = TRUE
* Set MotorReverse = FALSE
* Transition to State 5

State 5: Moving to Station C
- Wait for SensorC activation
- On activation:
* Set MotorForward = FALSE
* Transition to State 6

State 6: Processing at Station C
- Wait for ButtonC press
- On press:
* Turn on CompletionLight
* Transition to State 7

State 7: Cycle Completion
- Wait for product removal (NOT SensorC)
- On removal:
* Turn off CompletionLight
* Return to State 1

4. Motor Control Safety:
a. Manual Mode:
- Forward/Reverse mutual exclusion enforced by logic
- Both motors off when both or no buttons pressed

b. Automatic Mode:
- Always set MotorReverse = FALSE when activating forward motion
- Clear MotorForward when stopping at stations
- Never activate reverse motion in automatic mode

Note: The function block must maintain safe operation in both modes, with special attention to motor control signals to prevent any possibility of simultaneous forward and reverse operation.

FUNCTION_BLOCK FB_ProductionLineControl

VAR_INPUT 
Mode : BOOL; // Manual/Auto mode selection
ForwardButton : BOOL; // Forward rotation button
ReverseButton : BOOL; // Reverse rotation button
SensorA : BOOL; // Sensor A input
SensorB : BOOL; // Sensor B input
SensorC : BOOL; // Sensor C input
ButtonA : BOOL; // Button A input
ButtonB : BOOL; // Button B input
ButtonC : BOOL; // Button C input
END_VAR

VAR_OUTPUT 
MotorForward : BOOL; // Motor forward output
MotorReverse : BOOL; // Motor reverse output
CompletionLight : BOOL; // Process completion indicator
END_VAR

VAR 
State : INT; // State machine current state
END_VAR

END_FUNCTION_BLOCK

properties_to_be_validated.property_description: Verify that forward and reverse motor operations are mutually exclusive

property.pattern_description: {instance.MotorForward = TRUE AND instance.MotorReverse = TRUE} is impossible at the end of the PLC cycle.

properties_to_be_validated.property_description: Verify that State value remains within valid range (0-7)

property.pattern_description: {instance.State >= 0 AND instance.State <= 7} is always true at the end of the PLC cycle.

properties_to_be_validated.property_description: Verify manual mode forward motion control

pattern_params.0: NOT instance.Mode AND instance.ForwardButton AND NOT instance.ReverseButton

property.pattern_description: If {NOT instance.Mode AND instance.ForwardButton AND NOT instance.ReverseButton} is true at the end of the PLC cycle, then {instance.MotorForward = TRUE AND instance.MotorReverse = FALSE} should always be true at the end of the same cycle.

properties_to_be_validated.property_description: Verify manual mode reverse motion control

pattern_params.0: NOT instance.Mode AND instance.ReverseButton AND NOT instance.ForwardButton

property.pattern_description: If {NOT instance.Mode AND instance.ReverseButton AND NOT instance.ForwardButton} is true at the end of the PLC cycle, then {instance.MotorReverse = TRUE AND instance.MotorForward = FALSE} should always be true at the end of the same cycle.

properties_to_be_validated.property_description: Verify automatic mode motor control at station A

pattern_params.1: instance.MotorForward = TRUE AND instance.MotorReverse = FALSE AND instance.State = 3

property.pattern_description: If {instance.Mode AND instance.State = 2 AND instance.ButtonA} is true at the end of the PLC cycle, then {instance.MotorForward = TRUE AND instance.MotorReverse = FALSE AND instance.State = 3} should always be true at the end of the same cycle.

properties_to_be_validated.property_description: Verify motor stop at sensor B detection

property.pattern_description: If {instance.Mode AND instance.State = 3 AND instance.SensorB} is true at the end of the PLC cycle, then {instance.MotorForward = FALSE AND instance.State = 4} should always be true at the end of the same cycle.

properties_to_be_validated.property_description: Verify completion light control at station C

property.pattern_description: If {instance.Mode AND instance.State = 6 AND instance.ButtonC} is true at the end of the PLC cycle, then {instance.CompletionLight = TRUE AND instance.State = 7} should always be true at the end of the same cycle.

properties_to_be_validated.property_description: Verify completion light reset on product removal

pattern_params.0: instance.Mode AND instance.State = 7 AND NOT instance.SensorC

property.pattern_description: If {instance.Mode AND instance.State = 7 AND NOT instance.SensorC} is true at the end of the PLC cycle, then {instance.CompletionLight = FALSE AND instance.State = 1} should always be true at the end of the same cycle.

test_cases.description: Case 1: Initialization and Manual Mode Controls (Forward, Reverse, Stop).
notes: Cycle 6: Manual Stop (Fwd=T, Rev=T). Motors=F (Mutual Exclusion rule).
C8 (State 7 -> 1): **SensorC = F** (Product removed). CompletionLight = F. **State returns to 1.** (THIS WAS THE FAILURE POINT)

test_cases.description: Case 3: Testing intermediate states/outputs without trigger.
notes: C1-C2 (State 3): Moving (MotorForward=T) and waiting for SensorB. No trigger. State holds.
C4-C5 (State 4): Processing at B (Motors=F). No trigger (ButtonB). State holds.
